# Zafar Saleem

> Freelance web developer building fast, SEO-friendly landing pages and marketing websites for SaaS startups with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

## Key facts
- Services: SaaS landing pages, websites and microsites, performance fixes
- Typical delivery: Figma to live site in 2–3 weeks
- Pricing: landing pages from $1,500, websites from $3,500, custom projects from $6,000
- You own the code, domain and content
- Contact: zafarsaleem3@gmail.com
